title: Subtract transcendence degrees for an embedded coefficient field
statement: In the smooth integral finite-type K-scheme setting [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-pc-integral-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with K algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let d be the dimension of Y [def-kun-dimension] and let s:Spec(Omega) -> Y be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], with Omega algebraically closed, above y. Put a=trdeg_K kappa(y) [def-kun-transcendence-degree], and let R be the strict henselization ring [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], assumed local and an integral domain, with structural map r:Spec(R) -> Y. Equip kappa(y) with a K-algebra structure inducing the composite Spec(kappa(y)) -> Y -> Spec(K), and equip Omega with a kappa(y)-algebra structure inducing s after composition with Spec(kappa(y)) -> Y. Equip R with a K-algebra structure inducing r followed by Y -> Spec(K). For any K-field F and K-algebra map j:F -> R with trdeg_K F=a, the fraction field of R, regarded as an F-algebra through j, has transcendence degree d-a over F.

source.place: Proof, Local calculation in dimension d, first paragraph: lift a separating basis and its separable closure; second paragraph: subtract transcendence degrees

proof.text: Apply the closed-irreducible dimension formula to the whole integral scheme and its generic point. The generic stalk is a field and its surjective residue map is an isomorphism. The structural Spec equations identify the K-algebra structures. Thus trdeg_K K(Y)=d.

The core theorem provides i:K(Y) -> Q=Frac(R), with Q algebraic over K(Y). Full faithfulness of Spec and the structural equations show that i respects K. The tower formula, with zero transcendence degree for the algebraic extension, therefore gives trdeg_K Q=d.

Use j to define the F-algebra structure of Q. Since j respects K, K,F,Q is a scalar tower. The tower formula yields a+trdeg_F Q=d as cardinals. The right side is finite, so trdeg_F Q is a natural cardinal b. Injectivity of natural cardinal casts gives a+b=d and hence b=d-a, including the boundary cases a=0 and a=d.

theorem smooth_strict_local_field_model_coeff_fraction_trdeg
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [Smooth f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (d a : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Y = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y)
    (y : Y) (hy : s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = y)
    [Algebra K (Y.residueField y)]
    (hκ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (Y.residueField y))) =
      Y.fromSpecResidueField y ≫ f)
    [Algebra (Y.residueField y) Ω]
    (hΩ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.residueField y) Ω)) ≫
      Y.fromSpecResidueField y = s)
    (ha : Algebra.trdeg K (Y.residueField y) = (a : Cardinal))
    [Algebra K (strictHenselizationRing s)]
    (hK : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (strictHenselizationRing s))) =
      strictHenselizationStructuralMap s ≫ f)
    [IsLocalRing (strictHenselizationRing s)]
    [IsDomain (strictHenselizationRing s)]
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra K F]
    (j : F →ₐ[K] strictHenselizationRing s)
    (htr : Algebra.trdeg K F = (a : Cardinal)) :
    (letI := ((algebraMap (strictHenselizationRing s)
        (FractionRing (strictHenselizationRing s))).comp j.toRingHom).toAlgebra
     Algebra.trdeg F (FractionRing (strictHenselizationRing s)) =
       ((d - a : ℕ) : Cardinal))
